## Handover notes

- `a13-observability--alert-hygiene`: - `to_agent`: the agent that assigned the task (`A01` unless the task names another). `goal`: fix the rejected alerts. - `completed`: checks run. `remaining`: unlinked alerts and drifted rules. `open_questions`: missing `max_noise_ratio` or counts. `verification`: verified when coverage, drift and fatigue all ran. - When any alert is unlinked, write a second handover to `A15` listing only those alerts (runbook owner). - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--burn-evaluation`: - `to_agent`: `A12` when the evaluation serves a release decision, else the agent that assigned the task (`A01` unless the task names another). `goal`: the evaluated service and window. - `completed`: checks run. `decisions`: severity cited from `alert.sev`. `artifacts`: the incident record with its `shared_artifact_digest` digest, if one was written. `open_questions`: skipped windows. `verification`: verified only if every cross-check agreed, else partial with the gaps in `checks`. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--cardinality-guard`: - `to_agent`: the agent that proposed the metric (the task assigner; `A01` when unknown, often A05 or A06 in practice). `goal`: apply the label verdict. - `decisions`: keep, bucket or drop per label with the estimate. `remaining`: apply the change. `open_questions`: unknown counts. `verification`: verified when the estimate was tool-computed. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--dashboard-coverage`: - `to_agent`: `A15`. `goal`: document the coverage and link the bundle. - `artifacts`: `{kind: "dashboard.bundle", uri, digest, producer: "A13"}`. `remaining`: gap closure per journey. `open_questions`: journeys without owners. `verification`: verified when every age was tool-computed. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--deploy-telemetry-feed`: - `to_agent`: `A12`. `goal`: gate the next canary step for the release. - `decisions`: verdict with the burn and probe numbers as rationale. `open_questions`: missing p95 or skipped evidence. `constraints`: verdict is advisory. `verification`: verified only when script, recompute and probes all ran. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--escalation-timeline`: - `to_agent`: the `owner` returned by `shared_escalate`. `goal`: take incident command. - `completed`: actions so far. `remaining`: stabilization. `blockers`: awaiting humans. `artifacts`: `{kind, uri, digest, producer: "A13"}` for the incident record and timeline file. `verification`: partial (incident not stabilized). - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--incident-declare`: - `to_agent`: `A12`. `goal`: choose rollback or flag-off for the named release. - `decisions`: severity and rationale (window and burn). `artifacts`: `{kind: "incident.alert", uri: ".swarm/incidents/<id>.json", digest, producer: "A13"}`. `remaining`: A12 deploy decision, mitigation per `skill://a13-observability--mitigation-run`. `constraints`: A13 cannot stop or roll back releases. `verification`: verified when the cross-checks agreed. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--mitigation-run`: - `to_agent`: `A12`. `goal`: confirm stabilization or decide rollback. - `completed`: mitigation and evidence. `decisions`: gate reason. `remaining`: further steps or escalation. `blockers`: pending approvals. `verification`: verified when both burn samples exist. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--pipeline-degraded`: - `to_agent`: `A12`. `goal`: keep canaries halted while telemetry is degraded. - `completed`: lag and probe checks. `constraints`: no canary promotion, SLO status unknown. `remaining`: pipeline recovery. `verification`: partial or unverified per the probe result. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
- `a13-observability--slo-manifest-intake`: - `to_agent`: the agent that supplied the objective (`A03` or `A02`). `goal`: confirm the manifest matches the intended SLO. - `completed`: manifest defined. `remaining`: runbook creation if missing. `artifacts`: `{kind: "slo.manifest", uri, digest, producer: "A13"}`. `decisions`: objective source and rationale. `open_questions`: runbook gap. `verification`: status verified when the budget sample passed. - Tools: `shared_handover_validate` then `shared_handover_write`.
